observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructors present structured tambourine dance routines with scripture references, demonstrating each pattern at regular and slow motion speeds. They introduce each pattern verbally before performing alongside background music or count-ins.

lesson_structure.note: Hosts welcome viewers to CMA Dance Ministries channel and provide a disclaimer.
Full demonstration of tambourine dance steps.
Introduction of pattern 'Blessed' with scripture reference (Genesis 1:22).
Count-in and demonstration of Blessed pattern.
Slow motion demonstration of Blessed pattern.
Introduction of pattern 'Zion' with scripture reference (Isaiah 8:18).
Count-in and demonstration of Zion pattern.
Slow motion demonstration of Zion pattern.
Introduction of pattern 'Gospel' with scripture reference (Romans 1:16).
Slow demonstration of Gospel B pattern.

steps_taught.name: Blessed
steps_taught.description: Tambourine pattern with arm movements and ribbon flourishes.

steps_taught.name: Zion
steps_taught.description: Circle pattern with tambourine swings and steps.

steps_taught.name: Gospel
steps_taught.description: Praise pattern with overhead and side tambourine gestures.

what_works: Inclusion of slow motion demonstrations allows learners to follow intricate tambourine and arm placements.
Clear visual scripture references and pattern names organize the tutorial sections.
what_hinders: Lack of verbal breakdown of footwork and individual counts during slow demonstrations.

quotes.text: We will be doing the pattern Blessed, formerly known as cha-cha.
We will be doing the pattern Zion, formerly known as circle.
Today we will be doing the pattern Gospel in a slow demonstration.

evidence_segments.observation: Two speakers standing side by side talking directly to the camera with text overlays.
Two dancers in yellow overlays performing tambourine routines with ribbon attachments.
Dancers in red overlays executing tambourine arm extensions and turns.

extraction.distinctive_method: Associating each tambourine pattern with specific Bible verses and categorization labels like Gospel and Zion.
